subject: Data Engineering
title: Stale Data
description: A micro-lesson that makes Stale Data usable.

hook.text: The inventory dashboard says 500 units in stock. The warehouse shipped the last one yesterday.

buildup.text: Stale data occurs when the pipeline lag exceeds the business's tolerance for outdated information.

discovery.text: Freshness SLAs define the maximum acceptable lag. Breaking them means decisions are based on the past.

twist.text: Some staleness is acceptable. A weekly HR report doesn't need real-time data. A fraud alert does.

climax.text: Monitoring freshness and alerting on breaches prevents stale data from causing real-world harm.

punchline.text: Old data isn't wrong. It's just no longer true.

quiz.question: What defines whether data staleness is a problem?
options: Whether the lag exceeds the business's freshness tolerance
The number of columns in the table
